tasks.title: Wire accessibility audits into CI
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: ci-quality.yml runs scripts/audit-a11y.mjs and/or scripts/lighthouse-audit.mjs against a built/served site
AC-02: A failing WCAG 2.1 AA check fails the CI job, not just logs a warning
AC-03: Change is proposed as its own PR per gitops skill's CI-policy-change rule, not bundled into an unrelated change

tasks.title: Audit all docs/quickstarts/*.mdx against quickstart-validator checks
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Every QuickStart's module links resolve
AC-02: Every QuickStart's referenced modules carry stage/line tags consistent with the QuickStart's stated audience
AC-03: Findings reported as a gap report, not silently auto-fixed, per the audit agent's role

tasks.title: Audit module stage/line/tier tags against aqal-competency-map.md
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Every module's stage/line tags reflect its actual content per aqal-tagger's classification method
AC-02: Any module spanning two stages' worth of content is flagged for a split decision, not silently dual-tagged
AC-03: Findings reported as a gap report for human review before any re-tagging PR

tasks.title: Resolve placement-accuracy feedback-loop gap (design.md open question)
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Either a qualitative (pilot/facilitator feedback) or architectural (server-side, with its own discovery pass) mitigation is chosen and documented
AC-02: Decision recorded in docs/product/design.md's Open Architectural Questions section
AC-03: If a server-side component is chosen, it is scoped as its own docs/features/<slug>/ entry, not folded into this task

tasks.title: Reconcile ARCHITECTURE.md's module/quickstart counts with actual repo state
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Counts in ARCHITECTURE.md match `find docs/modules -name '*.md*' | wc -l` and `ls docs/quickstarts | wc -l` at time of edit

summary.note: Each task here is product-level and roadmap-shaped. A task graduates to its own docs/features/<slug>/ entry once picked up by feature-flow, per docs/product/README.md.
